verdict.rationale: Termius documents genuine bulk-operation features: broadcasting commands to all open sessions, running snippets across multiple hosts simultaneously, and group-level jump-host inheritance so many hosts share config without duplication. However, there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of these bulk features in the community evidence, and no API/CLI hooks for AI-native programmatic bulk automation are documented. Missing for 10: independent verification of broadcast/multi-host execution at scale, and evidence of scriptable/API-driven bulk operations for automation-depth use cases.
